CacheAuthority.description:
The permission scope attached to cached response content, independently of
storage lifetime and the durable mutation queue.

account.description: Account witness bound inside that profile when this generation began.

generation.description: Capture before acquiring source data; never relabel an older response.

identity.description: Anonymous physical cache profile, independent of the signed-in account.

policy.description: Server-defined policy value; absent before the first permission proof.

ready.description: False until all protected snapshots have been retired durably.

AuthorityTransition.description: Shared browser/native transport for a completed permission transition.

affectedOps.description: Host operation names whose previous results must be discarded.

changed.description: Whether the authority changed or incomplete retirement resumed.
